fields.statement: QA at b9129e145: go test -trimpath -p 2 -count=1 ./internal/proctree -v exit 0 (TestSessionTree, KeepsEachProcess, PrefixIsNotRoot, NotFound, ParseSkipsHeaderAndMalformed, ReadPSFails, ReadUsesTable PASS). Real 'ps -A -ww -o pid= -o ppid= -o rss= -o args=' on this Linux host prints live session roots as '<pid> <ppid> <rss> /home/rhiza/bin/rhiza session run <uuid>', the shape IsSessionRoot matches (fields 1-3 session/run/id, whole-id match). Code read: one ps call, no /proc, no OS-specific call, not-found is an error, rss KiB x 1024.

QA at b9129e145 with a scratch build in a scratch root and project: rhiza daemon settings lists runawayProcs 400, runawayMemory 8G, runawayGrace 5m (default) for machine and project; daemon set machine runawayMemory 12G/512M and runawayProcs 0 land in rhiza.toml, project runawayProcs 50/runawayMemory 2G/runawayGrace 90s land in git config and show (git config, project); 'runawayMemory lots' refused naming the key (exit 2), '-- runawayProcs -1' and '1.5' refused naming the key, runawayGrace 0 refused. go test ./internal/api -run TestWatchdogPolicy (runaway_keys, project_over_machine) and TestScripts/watchdog-policy exit 0; rhiza docs --out scratch gives config.md byte-identical to docs/reference/config.md.

QA at b9129e145 (no real daemon or runaway, per brief): go test -trimpath -p 2 -count=1 ./internal/api -run 'TestWatchdogRunaway|TestWatchdogStalled|TestWatchdogPolicy' exit 0 (TestWatchdogRunaway, SpawnedChild, NoHostTable, LeftAlone under_both/no_tree/attended/back_under/threshold_off, all Stalled tests); go test ./internal/daemon -run Resumable exit 0 (a runaway-stopped run is not resumed, a waiting stop is). Code read: watchdogProcTable is nil under RHIZA_TEST_NOW, the stall pass carries the runaway nudge memory from prev, a stopped run is dropped from the stall pass that poll, the stopped detail begins 'watchdog: runaway ' which Resumable skips, and an owner resume re-entering the step clears Stopped.
